root_cause: The gateway applied an incorrect fee percentage or overcharged MDR on a PPI Wallet UPI transaction relative to the defined rule schedule.
diagnosis: Transaction TXN_000498 was charged Rs 49.18 in fees instead of the expected Rs 40.24, resulting in an excess fee leakage of Rs 8.94 for this PPI Wallet UPI payment.
action_rationale: Requesting an MDR refund directly addresses the identified overcharge of Rs 8.94 on the verified transaction fee delta.
